headline.en: Check the tool-call path before connecting an agent.
headline.zh: 接入 Agent 前，先检查工具调用链路。

sub.en: ReadyGate runs a small tool-call probe suite against a configured endpoint and records endpoint, structured-call and argument-JSON results.
sub.zh: ReadyGate 对配置端点运行小型工具调用探针集，记录端点、结构化调用与参数 JSON 三层结果。

body.en: Separate response availability, call structure and argument JSON.
body.zh: 分别检查响应可用性、调用结构与参数 JSON。

body.en: Supported request repairs are visible in the result.
body.zh: 支持的请求修复在结果中可见。

body.en: JSON output carries suite and layer evidence.
body.zh: JSON 输出包含探针集与分层证据。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Pass an explicit single-quoted arguments fixture through strict and repaired validation.
note.zh: 将明确给出的单引号参数 fixture 交给严格校验与修复校验。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Pure response validation and supported JSON normalization on an explicit malformed fixture; no live endpoint readiness certificate.

body.en: Pass an explicit single-quoted arguments fixture through strict and repaired validation.
body.zh: 将明确给出的单引号参数 fixture 交给严格校验与修复校验。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/readygate.git
cd readygate
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: A passing suite is bounded to those probes. It does not prove general agent readiness, full argument-schema conformance or long-term endpoint stability.
limitations.zh: 探针通过只覆盖这些案例，不证明通用 Agent 能力、完整参数 schema 合规或长期端点稳定性。

limitations.en: Repair applies to this probe workflow and does not persistently fix the server or configure another harness.
limitations.zh: 修复作用于本探测流程，不会持久修改服务器或配置其他调用框架。

limitations.en: The recorded offline example exercises the validator on a fixture and does not certify a live endpoint.
limitations.zh: 记录的离线示例只在 fixture 上运行校验器，不认证在线端点。

body.en: An HTTP response alone does not show that the endpoint emits usable tool calls. Separate layers make it easier to locate a broken response format before a longer agent task begins.
body.zh: HTTP 能响应并不代表端点能输出可用工具调用。分层检查有助于在长任务开始前定位响应格式问题。

body.en: ProbeEngine selects the model profile and sends the suite. Strict validation records initial failures; repair_for modifies supported request hints and a single retry is validated with supported argument normalization. The certificate emitter summarizes the initial and final layer results.
body.zh: ProbeEngine 选择模型配置并发送探针。严格校验记录初始失败；repair_for 修改支持的请求提示，重试一次后结合支持的参数归一化再验证。证书模块汇总前后三层结果。

body.en: ProbeEngine selects the model profile and sends the suite. Strict validation records initial failures; repair_for modifies supported request hints and a single retry is validated with supported argument normalization. The certificate emitter summarizes the initial and final layer results.
body.zh: ProbeEngine 选择模型配置并发送探针。严格校验记录初始失败；repair_for 修改支持的请求提示，重试一次后结合支持的参数归一化再验证。证书模块汇总前后三层结果。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: probe accepts an endpoint, optional --model, --out/-o certificate destination and --timeout/-t. Without --model, the engine queries /models. Online probing makes real requests to the supplied endpoint; the included offline script only calls pure validators.
body.zh: probe 接收端点、可选 --model、--out/-o 结果路径与 --timeout/-t。省略 --model 时查询 /models。在线探测会实际请求指定端点；随仓离线脚本只调用纯校验器。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
readygate probe http://localhost:8000/v1 --model your-model -o readygate-cert.json
readygate probe http://localhost:8000/v1 --timeout 60
